reviews.evidence: Shows file/command automation, schedules, triggers, IM, browser/computer control, memory, sample prompts, extensive screenshots, diagnostics, safeguards, and tests.
reviews.concern: DSH runtime support is explicitly still in progress; stable releases use Abu's native harness.

reviews.evidence: Documents 30+ guarded UI components, local interactions, panels and persistence, install verification, JSON examples, real video/screenshots, limits, FAQ, tests, and E2E.
reviews.concern: Requires host client activation/restart; DOM fallback still depends on host fence surfaces despite drift guards.

reviews.evidence: Shows a multi-provider protocol gateway, profiles, routing, OAuth, tenant tokens, analytics and IM control, with SDK calls, remote steps, GIFs, screenshots, and build commands.
reviews.concern: Most routing claims lack worked policy examples; troubleshooting and quantified validation are thin.

reviews.evidence: Its own shipped behavior is a daily-curated, taxonomized directory with canonical repository links, section browsing, inclusion criteria, and independently checked reference links.
reviews.concern: It has no operational workflow or demos beyond its tables; linked projects' capabilities receive no credit.

reviews.evidence: Provides offline HarmonyOS references, task/kit lookup, a smoke fixture, device evidence, UI action, UX and trace audit scripts, cross-agent installs, safety rules, and tests.
reviews.concern: No end-to-end retrieval transcript or resulting code/report is shown; several script examples end in ellipses.

reviews.evidence: Details three-layer code scanning, authorized pentesting, TUI/IDE/MCP, reports and snapshots, complete commands, video/screenshots, scope enforcement, limits, and test results.
reviews.concern: README gives test counts, but not detailed coverage or a representative rendered scan report.

reviews.evidence: Covers spot/perps/limit trading, wallets, transfers, market data and x402 across many networks; supplies natural-language operating flows and a 76-scenario safety benchmark.
reviews.concern: No transaction-result demo is shown, and confirmations, slippage limits, and loss controls are not spelled out.

reviews.evidence: Parses papers, builds quick/deep study materials, code notebooks, figures and a searchable web library; includes cross-agent commands/prompts, output tree, screenshots, and tests.
reviews.concern: No sample generated summary/notebook or parser failure and troubleshooting walkthrough is shown.

reviews.evidence: Ships typed schematic/PCB automation, validated circuit blocks, exports and audits; shows real editor GIFs/screenshots, measured gates, recovery, limits, and E2E cases.
reviews.concern: PCB automation remains partial: dense routing, impedance, undo, teardrops, and incremental import have limits.

reviews.evidence: Packages DSH as a desktop app with plugin management, safe-mode repair, archives, notifications and loopback lifecycle; shows UI screenshots, checksums, limits, and builds.
reviews.concern: Little task-level operating guidance or explicit scenarios are given; many abilities are inherited from upstream DSH.
